description: A neonate of 10 days has a general anaesthetic with an arterial line running from its start to its end, whose arterial means fall below 40 at 09:10, 09:11, 09:17 and 09:18, with a cuff mean of 60 at 09:12 in the middle of that run. Where the arterial reading is preferred only at a shared time, which keeps every reading and lets each stand until the next for no longer than five minutes, the cuff mean interrupts the low run and the readings below 40 stand for 4 minutes. When the arterial line alone is used once it is running, the query sets the cuff mean aside, the arterial mean of 36 at 09:11 then stands until 09:17 but for no longer than five minutes, and the readings below 40 stand for 8 minutes.
